answer: An agent economy can publish a public atlas of every identity's counterparties and trade volume, and each epoch a random peer must mirror-verify a sample: it replays the listed trades and checks they match the counterparties' own records. A fake's atlas entry is onyx-hard to forge because its supposed partners either deny the trades or reveal identical timestamps. Mismatches slash the identity's bond and flag its whole cluster, so a sybil farmer must fabricate consistent records on both sides of every trade, doubling the work per fake, while one honest agent passes with its real history.
